steps.title: Wash leaf in solvent
steps.instruction: Remove the radioactive‑herbicide‑treated leaf from the plant and vortex it in 10 mL of 10 % MeOH or ACN containing 0.25 % NIS inside a 20 mL scintillation vial.

steps.title: Combine leaf with shoot tissue and count wash
steps.instruction: Transfer the washed leaf from the scintillation vial to the remaining shoot tissue, add 10 mL scintillation cocktail, and count the leaf wash on a liquid scintillation counter to determine % absorption for later mass‑balance calculations.

steps.title: Grind frozen plant material
steps.instruction: Place whole plants in a 10 mL disposable glass test tube, add liquid nitrogen, and grind with a glass rod until the tissue is as fine as possible.

steps.title: Extract tissue with buffer and shake
steps.instruction: Suspend the ground tissue in the extraction solution (recipe in Materials), wrap the tube in diaper paper, place on a shaker for 30 minutes, then add extraction buffer and grind as described.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 mL extraction buffer to the tube and grind the tissue with a glass rod.
Add an additional 2.5 mL extraction buffer to a clean glass rod and repeat grinding.

steps.title: Load extract onto spin filter
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire 5 mL of extraction buffer‑plant mixture to a 0.45 µm Ciro Nylon Maxi‑Spin Filter Tube, then rinse the original glass tube with 2.5 mL + 2.5 mL extraction solution and add the rinsate to the filter tube (total volume 10 mL).

steps.title: Take aliquot for scintillation counting
steps.instruction: Remove 10 µL of the filtrate into a scintillation vial and count on the liquid scintillation counter.

steps.title: Centrifuge filter tube
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the Ciro filter tube at approximately 4700 rpm for 10 minutes to separate liquid from plant debris.

steps.title: Dispose of radioactive glass vial
steps.instruction: Discard the radioactive 10 mL glass vial (retain the cap for later washing).

steps.title: Verify acidification of extract
steps.instruction: Test the liquid herbicide extract with litmus paper to confirm proper acidification before loading onto the C18 SPE column.

steps.title: Rinse filter component
steps.instruction: Rinse the filter component of the Ciro tube with 5 mL extraction buffer.

steps.title: Dry filter component and store
steps.instruction: Remove the entire filter component, place it in an envelope, and dry in a drying oven. Once dry, carefully retrieve the filter papers and plant material; store at –20 °C until oxidation.

steps.title: Count oxidizer solution
steps.instruction: Remove 10 µL from the oxidizer solution and count on the liquid scintillation counter, or count the entire oxidizer solution.

steps.title: Set up C18 SPE vacuum manifold
steps.instruction: Assemble the vacuum manifold: place one Sep‑Pak C18 filter on the manifold, attach a glass syringe to the filter, and position two labeled glass tubes in the test‑tube holder for each sample.

steps.title: Precondition C18 column
steps.instruction: Pre‑condition the C18 Sep‑Pak column with approximately 1 mL of 100 % acetonitrile (ACN).

steps.title: Pass extract through C18 column and rinse
steps.instruction: Pour the extraction buffer from the Ciro tube through the C18 SPE column for each sample, then rinse the Ciro tube with X mL of acidified water to bring the total volume to 10 mL.

steps.title: Elute metabolites with acetonitrile
steps.instruction: Switch the vacuum manifold to a new labeled tube and run a total of 5 mL 100 % ACN (2.5 mL + 2.5 mL) through the column to elute fluroxypyr‑ester, fluroxypyr‑acid, and fluroxypyr metabolites.

steps.title: Evaporate acetonitrile overnight
steps.instruction: Place the eluate samples in the fume hood and allow the ACN to evaporate overnight.

steps.title: Reconstitute residue in HPLC solvent A
steps.instruction: After evaporation, add HPLC solvent A to the residue, vortex several times, and resuspend the material in the test tube.

steps.title: Filter reconstituted solution
steps.instruction: Pass the reconstituted solution through a nylon syringe filter to remove particulates, then transfer the filtrate into a small liquid vial for HPLC analysis.

steps.title: Take subsample before HPLC injection
steps.instruction: Withdraw a 10 µL subsample before HPLC injection to determine the ratio of parent compound (fluroxypyr‑ester) to metabolites.

steps.title: Count subsample on scintillation counter
steps.instruction: Collect 10 µL from the pulled liquid and count on the liquid scintillation counter.
